evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
8 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

plan: Drive: from District of Tumbler Ridge, about 74 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 54.52238, -120.90374, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the unnamed road stretch, 3.2 km one way. About 64 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-21, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-25, closures 2026-10-16.
